sk.title: Školská jedáleň
brief: Školská jedáleň na gymnáziu v Poprade varí každý deň niekoľko špeciálnych diétnych porcií a študenti si ich musia vopred rezervovať. Každá porcia má kód a názov jedla. Každý študent má meno a triedu a kuchárka musí vedieť, ktorý študent si rezervoval ktorú porciu.
Kuchárka pridá porciu príkazom `addportion`, za ktorým nasleduje jej kód a jedlo. Program odpovie `Portion P1 added.`

Študent si porciu rezervuje príkazom `reserve`, za ktorým nasleduje kód porcie, meno študenta a jeho trieda. Ak je porcia ešte voľná, program odpovie `Portion P1 reserved for Tomas (1A).` Ak je už rezervovaná, odpovie `Portion P1 is already reserved.` Ak taká porcia neexistuje, odpovie `Portion P9 does not exist.`

Príkaz `class`, za ktorým nasleduje trieda, vypíše každú porciu, ktorú si rezervoval študent z tejto triedy, na samostatný riadok, napríklad `P1 risotto Tomas` (kód, jedlo, študent), v poradí, v akom boli porcie pridané. Ak taká porcia nie je, vypíše `No portions for class 1A.` (s triedou, na ktorú sa pýtame).

Program číta jeden príkaz na riadok a skončí príkazom `exit`. Každá hodnota v príkaze je jedno slovo. Okrem uvedených odpovedí program nevypisuje nič – žiadne menu, uvítanie ani výzvy na zadanie. Odpovede píš presne tak, ako sú uvedené (po anglicky).

en.title: School Cafeteria
brief: The school cafeteria at the grammar school in Poprad cooks a few special diet portions every day, and students must reserve them in advance. Every portion has a code and the name of the dish. Every student has a name and a class, and the cook must know which student has reserved which portion.
The cook adds a portion with the command `addportion`, followed by its code and the dish. The program replies `Portion P1 added.`

A student reserves a portion with `reserve`, followed by the portion code, the student's name and class. If the portion is still free, the program replies `Portion P1 reserved for Tomas (1A).` If it is already reserved, it replies `Portion P1 is already reserved.` If there is no such portion, it replies `Portion P9 does not exist.`

The command `class`, followed by a class, lists every portion reserved by a student of that class on its own line, like `P1 risotto Tomas` (code, dish, student), in the order the portions were added. If there is none, it prints `No portions for class 1A.` (with the class that was asked for).

The program reads one command per line and ends with the command `exit`. Every value in a command is a single word. Apart from the replies above, the program prints nothing – no menu, no welcome text, no prompts.

design.link: Portion.Student → Student (one-way: the portion knows who reserved it)

scenarios.en: Reserving a free portion assigns the student
Reserving a portion that is already reserved fails
The list of a class's portions is exact
Reserving a portion that does not exist fails
